description: This source file defines a React functional component 'CompatibilityOverrides' which provides a UI control for adjusting skill proficiencies and triggers recalculations of role compatibility scores based on user input. It utilizes hooks like useState, useEffect, and useMemo, referencing external scoring functions and data types, and is part of a frontend project related to career navigation.

methods.name: CompatibilityOverrides
methods.description: React component that renders sliders for skill proficiency adjustments and calls a callback with recalculated compatibility info whenever the user modifies the skills.
